dataflowId.title: Dataflow ID
dataflowId.description: ABS dataflow identifier, e.g. "ABS_REGIONAL_ASGS2016" or a census table like "C21_G01_LGA". Find IDs in the ABS Data Explorer (explore.data.abs.gov.au) or at https://api.data.abs.gov.au/dataflow.

dataKey.title: Data key
dataKey.description: SDMX data key selecting dimension values, dot-separated and positional (e.g. "1.AUS.A"). Use "all" for the whole dataflow (can be large). Build keys in the ABS Data Explorer.

startPeriod.title: Start period
startPeriod.description: Earliest period, e.g. "2016" or "2020-Q1". Leave blank for all.

endPeriod.title: End period
endPeriod.description: Latest period. Leave blank for all.

version.title: Dataflow version
version.description: Optional explicit version (e.g. "1.0.0"). Leave blank for the latest.
